WITH functions AS (
                 SELECT to_regprocedure('mesh_jobs.try_renew(text,uuid,uuid,bigint)') AS renew,
                        to_regprocedure('mesh_jobs.settle_state(text,uuid,uuid,jsonb,boolean)') AS settle,
                        to_regprocedure('mesh_jobs.claim_batch_v1(text,text,jsonb,bigint,integer,bigint)') AS batch,
                        to_regprocedure('mesh_jobs.claim_drain_v1(text,text,jsonb,bigint,bigint,jsonb)') AS single_claim,
                        to_regprocedure('mesh_jobs.claim_batch_set_v1(text,text,jsonb,bigint,integer,bigint)') AS batch_set
             ) SELECT CASE
                 WHEN version <> 1 OR to_regclass('mesh_jobs.cron_schedules') IS NULL
                     OR renew IS NULL OR settle IS NULL THEN 'migrate'
                 WHEN NOT (has_function_privilege(renew, 'EXECUTE')
                     AND has_function_privilege(settle, 'EXECUTE')) THEN 'permissions'
                 WHEN $1::boolean AND batch IS NULL THEN 'migrate'
                 WHEN $1::boolean AND NOT has_function_privilege(batch, 'EXECUTE') THEN 'batch_permissions'
                 WHEN $2::boolean AND single_claim IS NULL THEN 'migrate'
                 WHEN $2::boolean AND NOT has_function_privilege(single_claim, 'EXECUTE') THEN 'single_permissions'
                 WHEN $3::boolean AND batch_set IS NULL THEN 'migrate'
                 WHEN $3::boolean AND NOT has_function_privilege(batch_set, 'EXECUTE') THEN 'batch_set_permissions'
                 ELSE 'ready'
             END FROM mesh_jobs.schema_version CROSS JOIN functions WHERE singleton

SELECT status, id, token, context, timeout_ms, context_bytes,
                CASE WHEN $6::boolean AND status = 'claimed'
                    THEN mesh_jobs.now_ms()::text END AS observed_at_ms, ordinality::text
         FROM mesh_jobs.claim_batch_set_v1($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::bigint, $5::integer, NULL)
         WITH ORDINALITY

WITH clock AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS now_ms)
         SELECT coalesce((
             SELECT greatest(j.scheduled_at_ms - (SELECT now_ms FROM clock), 0)::text
             FROM mesh_jobs.queues q JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j
                 ON j.namespace = q.namespace AND j.queue = q.name
             WHERE q.namespace = $1 AND q.name = $2 AND q.state = 'active' AND q.concurrency > 0
                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.queues paused
                     WHERE paused.namespace = $1 AND paused.name = '' AND paused.state = 'paused')
                 AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable')
                 AND j.scheduled_at_ms > $4::bigint AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                             WHERE w.worker = j.worker AND w.version = j.version)
             ORDER BY j.scheduled_at_ms LIMIT 1
         ), '')
